versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file to simplify the repository structure.
- No functional or feature changes to the core logic; all existing features and safety mechanisms remain in place.
- The documentation in SKILL.md is unchanged except for clarifying that SSH/psql access should not use sudo and must rely on user-level permissions.
- All security best practices and only-read operations are emphasized as before.

Version 1.0.1 — Introduces security & privacy clarifications; refines usage scope

- Added clear security, privacy, and only-read access statements throughout documentation.
- Refined activation conditions: now requires explicit user intent for work statistics; casual mentions of GitLab won't trigger analysis.
- Updated server configuration guidance for more secure credential usage.
- Clarified minimum data collection: avoids collecting sensitive personal info unless needed for self-analysis.
- Simplified file structure by removing skill-card.md.

gitlab-work-stats v1.0.0 initial release

- Introduces a tool for analyzing user work activity on self-hosted GitLab Omnibus servers.
- Supports generating reports on merge requests, code commits/pushes, and code reviews within specified time ranges.
- Extracts key parameters (GitLab username, date range, optional project) from user input.
- Connects via SSH and queries PostgreSQL database and git repositories in read-only mode.
- Provides clear report structures and asks for required parameters if missing.
